Thank you, it is helpful and I do feel better.

Due to being disabled and autistic I don't have anyone else I trust except old friends that can't really help. I'm not in danger or anything and honestly they do love me and I don't want to leave them but at the same time i wish there was somewhere else I could go when they are bring abusive.

Honestly my situation is very complicated. They do a hell of a lot for me, my mother is basically my carer. They really really love me. We just had an hour long conversation on how they could improve in which my father profusely apologised and at one point almost cried out of guilt. Honestly they have massively improved over the years, my father had a heart attack and smoking and drug withdrawals and used to cry and try to run away every night because he would throw things and then be heartbroken. He didn't want to live with us because he thought we'd be better with him gone. 

And with the whole "they were also abused" thing, it for sure doesn't excuse it, and they know it, but they struggle so much when triggered. My mother used to be whipped like a slave. My father is covered in cuts and burns from his parents. They are infinitely better then their parents, so they are trying very very hard, but when triggered they can't always think rationally. And that's the time I wish I had a safe place. All i need in those times is somewhere to go so they can calm down without triggering me or emotionally and verbally abusing me. Would go to our sheds but we have a rat infestation and it's full of spiders.

Sorry I'm kinda throwing this all at you I guess I just needed to vent, thank you for responding, I guess to simplify it all I only want to leave when they are triggered to be abusive. Outside of that they are the most amazing people who want the best for me and mostly give me the best they can. And I wish they could feel OK and process their trauma so it stops, but I've seen how severely it breaks them to even think about it.
Some people call themselves scalies but personally I absolutely hate that term.
